colors.strategy: 90-95% neutral; LoomLogic blue reserved for selection, focus, status, and signature detail

must: Use registry files as catalog source of truth
Keep LL Core as the only UI kit inheritance root
Keep package approval separate from Codex skill promotion
Support complete light and dark modes and reduced motion
avoid: CMS, database, authentication, and drag-drop builder behavior
Pervasive blue, glass, gradients, decorative motion, and rounded-everything styling

decisions.decision: Use a calm neutral editorial workbench with a compact package rail, centered preview canvas, and right-side property inspector.
decisions.reason: Supports dense design-system work while preserving LoomLogic's restrained luxury-tech character.

decisions.decision: Use semantic React primitives with shadcn-style explicit APIs and no new runtime UI dependency for V1.
decisions.reason: The repository had no established stack; native semantics keep V1 accessible and dependency-light.
